title: Affine-presentation sheafification for coefficient-sized comparison
statement: For X, a commutative ring A in max(v,u+1), an A-module sheaf G on the coefficient-sized etale model of def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, and an affine etale presentation P of det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map indexed in universe u+1, the unit from the presheaf left Kan extension of G along the opposite comparison inclusion to its pro-etale sheafification is invertible both at AsSmall.up(P.cone.pt) and at every AsSmall.up(P.diagram.obj i). This asserts only pointwise invertibility of sheafification, not that any section cocone is a colimit.

proof.text: On the original affine pro-etale basis, restrict the coefficient-sized Kan extension along AffineProEt.toProEt followed by AsSmall.up. For a universe-u cofiltered affine etale diagram, Scheme.preservesColimit_yoneda gives the colimit of the representable Hom presheaves. Lift these Hom sets through ULift, obtaining exactly the representables of the coefficient-sized model. The fully faithful Kan-extension colimit criterion of CategoryTheory/Pro/PresheafColimit then proves relative filtered-colimit preservation of this restriction. Only universe-u diagrams are used in this sheaf-condition argument.

Restriction further to affine etale objects identifies the Kan extension with the given etale sheaf using the invertible Kan-extension unit. Apply Presheaf.isSheaf_of_generates_of_isRelativelyPresentable to AffineProEt.minimalPrecoverage: its covers are finite and relatively presentable, and filtered colimits of the displayed coefficient-sized modules commute with finite limits. Thus the restricted Kan extension is a sheaf on the affine basis.

The affine-basis inclusion followed by AsSmall.up is a dense subsite of the coefficient-sized pro-etale model: compose the two covering-sieve equivalences, and use cover density under composition with an equivalence. The dense-subsite sheafification-unit theorem now makes the actual toSheafify map invertible at every affine pro-etale basis object.

Each affine etale stage is a basis object. For the vertex choose a stage i and restrict the original cone along Over.forget i. This functor is initial. Full faithfulness of Spec identifies its affine global-sections cocone with a ring colimit. The structure maps from the ring of stage i are etale because maps between etale X-schemes are etale. Apply ind_etale_small_index to their universe-(u+1) presentation; proAffineEtale_iff_appTop then proves that the projection to i is pro-affine-etale. Compose with the affine etale structure map of stage i. Apply the basis result to this vertex and to each stage, giving the required conjunction with the original universe-(u+1) presentation unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientComparison_presentation_toSheafify_isIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (G : Sheaf (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (P : AffinePresentation X I) :
    let L := (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).op.lan.obj G.obj
    let η := toSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) L
    IsIso (η.app (op (AsSmall.up.obj P.cone.pt))) ∧
      ∀ i : I, IsIso (η.app (op (AsSmall.up.obj (P.diagram.obj i))))
